name: react_deeponet_h2_protocol_reconstruction
source_table: Table 1, H2 column; this is the 2023 conference protocol, not a claim of identical 2024 journal implementation

reported_settings.transform: fifth root, followed by linear scaling to [-1,1]

declared_reconstruction_choices.framework: PyTorch CPU instead of author JAX/A100
declared_reconstruction_choices.mechanism: Cantera 3.2 h2o2.yaml with all ten species, including AR; author mechanism version unavailable
declared_reconstruction_choices.activation: tanh hidden layers; linear output layers; not specified by the preprint
declared_reconstruction_choices.output_partition: 200 branch and trunk features are each split into 5 groups of 40, followed by five inner products and biases
declared_reconstruction_choices.shift: additive shift in affine-normalized log(time), supported by Kumar thesis chapter 3; exact 2023 code unavailable
declared_reconstruction_choices.sampling: Every stored training state before the final 20-us window is eligible; sample future intervals 0.1 through 20 us uniformly without materializing the Cartesian pairs
declared_reconstruction_choices.normalization: Fit fifth-root min/max on training trajectories only; identical scale for current and future states; predict future state directly, not an increment
declared_reconstruction_choices.split_note: Exact author trajectory split is ambiguous; freeze an explicit disjoint split before training. The published phi=1,T=1065 curve is a seen-IC diagnostic here, not an unseen-test claim
declared_reconstruction_choices.remaining_species_network: Separate 5-64-64-6 tanh ANN, 20000 Adam updates, batch4096, lr0.001. Its architecture/training were not specified by the preprint. Constant AR=0 is preserved as a declared data constant
declared_reconstruction_choices.validation_selection: Raw representative-state macro-rollout completion, then joint5 NRMSE<=0.1 count, then median worst5, then fixed-window validation MSE. No test-driven selection
declared_reconstruction_choices.evaluation: 25 self-fed 20-us boundaries. Also query the interior 0.1-us grid from each predicted window start; interior queries do not feed back or receive reference states
declared_reconstruction_choices.extra_evaluation: Report raw representative-only, strict raw full-state and separately current-project elemental/enthalpy repaired full-state rollouts
